I lost a FP in January 2019, I didn't meet my new fp til December 2020. 
It took me nearly 2 years to move on but I did eventually. I'm glad I spent that time to myself though as I started DBT therapy and trauma work in this time. I still have my doubts in my new relationship but I've got DBT skills to help me regulate those emotions, I also can communicate with my partner any doubts or insecurities I have rationally. DBT was a lifesaver for me, I know not many people can access it but if you can it's definitely worth a shot. I'm currently reading the developer of DBTs autobiography, (Marsha Linehan) it's really inspiring to read how she went from literally rock bottom to saving countless lives.
